```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(readxl)

set.seed(1)
```

## Functions

Start small with Z scores

```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

Turn this into a function

```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
   if (!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Argument x should be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) == 1) {
    stop("Z scores cannot be computed for length 1 vectors")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x) 
  
  return(z)
  
}
```

Checking if it works

```{r eval = FALSE}
z_scores(x_vec)
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))
```

^ this works just lots of numbers 

```{r eval = FALSE}
z_scores(c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE))
z_scores("HELLOOOOO")
```

^ this doesn't

## Mean and SD

```{r}
mean(x_vec)
sd(x_vec)
```

Write a function that returns mean and sd of an input vector.

```{r}
source("source/mean_and_sd.R")
```

Check that this works

```{r}
mean_and_sd(x_vec)
```
